name: ThaiNamthip Corporation
aliases: ไทยน้ำทิพย์
desc: Family-founded Coca-Cola licensee bottling and distributing Coca-Cola system drinks and Namthip water across Thailand from several factories.
products: Coca-Cola system soft drinks, Namthip drinking water
stores_or_sites: Factories at Rangsit, Pathum Thani, Lampang, Khon Kaen

alt_indicators.evidence: Rangsit factory on 205 rai serving nationwide distribution; Lampang 100-150m litres a year

signals.what: Converted to a public limited company, preparing to list on the Stock Exchange of Thailand
Coca-Cola campaign with PTT Station; Real Magic charity run 2026

fit_rationale: Thailand's Coca-Cola bottler preparing a stock-market listing; marketing reach in Thailand is real but Thailand has no Grand Prix and Coca-Cola brand rules apply.
category_conflict: potential: PepsiCo is a Formula 1 partner (soft drinks)
outstanding: Revenue and employees (no page found); once listed it becomes ineligible
sources: https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/ไทยน้ำทิพย์

name: Coca-Cola Bottlers Uzbekistan
desc: State-majority Coca-Cola bottler in Uzbekistan with four production plants in Tashkent, Namangan and Urgench.
parent_ultimate: Republic of Uzbekistan; The Coca-Cola Company 42.882%
fit_rationale: Revenue above USD 150m only in an old 2019 figure; single-country bottler with no Grand Prix market, so kept on watch rather than MAIN.
category_conflict: potential: PepsiCo is a Formula 1 partner (soft drinks)
outstanding: Current revenue; status of state share sale (Rothschild mandate Dec 2020)
